steps.title: Tuning
steps.text: The tune is the heart of the build. Your tune is custom written for your truck and the parts you choose below. EcoDiesel tuning runs on HP Tuners. 2014-2019 trucks need 4 credits and 2020-2023 trucks need 6. 2018 and newer trucks also need extra HP Tuners hardware or an unlock, so ask us what your year needs: (250) 261-9502.

steps.title: Tuning Device
steps.text: The device loads your tune onto the truck. Already have one? Skip this step.

steps.title: Delete Pipe
steps.text: The pipe that replaces the factory DPF section. Pick the one for your year. Optional.

steps.title: EGR
steps.text: EGR kit for 2014-2018 trucks. Optional. Skip it if you don't need it.
